page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9ae.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured within the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9T95 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

The hardware profile of this instance emphasizes memory capacity over raw compute power or local storage speed. With 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, the instance provides a cost-efficient configuration for workloads that require substantial memory footprints without the overhead of high vCPU counts. This resource density makes it suitable for memory-intensive applications such as medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and data processing tasks that fit within the 64.0 GB memory boundary.
